description:
Return a queued owned-job receipt (data.job_id and data.status). Read the exact id through job_service.get_job for the complete former response in job.result or the typed failure in job.error. Admission retains payload references locally; uncertain effects require reconciliation and must never be replayed automatically.

Rebuild the memory-vector namespace: clear every vector, then reindex every live memory from its content. A one-shot operator-gated repair for pre-existing orphan vectors (the cascade-vector-first delete paths now prevent new orphans by construction). The namespace is shared by ACT-R memories and knowledge-base chunks, so one rebuild covers both. dry_run reports the would-be cleared and reindexed counts without mutating; the destructive run requires confirm=true because it wipes every vector before regenerating.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: The complete memory-operation response from the exact admitted job; the immediate response is a queued job receipt.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Rebuilding the shared memory-vector namespace (clear all vectors, then reindex every live memory)
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: rebuild_not_confirmed: the destructive run needs confirm=true. vector_clear_failed: the vector namespace could not be cleared. VectorStoreError: failed to access vector storage.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For rebuild_not_confirmed: re-invoke with confirm=true, or dry_run=true to preview the counts. For clear or store errors: verify vector storage is accessible.
